$comment: S17. Query expansion reaching the product's own ranking, §13.377.4's pre-registered dispatch. The one departure from the registered flag table is `queryExpansion: llm`. Read against `S16` (run 44017278305) question by question on the majority verdict, which is the field the published 84.30% was counted from. E1 missed and E3 fired: the pair is three days and four merged features apart, so the delta is a reading of two code versions rather than of one flag.

discordant.population: MR, the cell E1 is written over

discordantAll.population: all 500 questions — the five flips outside `MR` are E3's observation

bill.notCounted: the four extra query embeddings per expanded question are not in the artifact; the provider's own usage block does not separate them, so this bill is a floor

receipt.note: queries > indexes is the product's own counter, not the arm's claim: the phrases reached the ranking. This is the one thing the dispatch proved.

promptIdentity.note: every one of the fifty moved with its delivered evidence bytes unchanged (`evidenceChars` and `evidenceTurns` equal), and forty-eight of them are the temporal route. Same evidence under a different prompt is a renderer change, not a retrieval change: the expansion is confined to `MR` by `expandMultiSessionQueries`'s routing rule and `queryExpansionCounts.questions` is 121, the `MR` population exactly. So something other than the declared flag moved them.

configuration.note: `memoryArmConfig` is projected from the code that produced the artifact, so a key on one side only is a merged feature. The control was written on 2026-11-17 and carries none of the four; its `selfIndex` has no `queries` field at all, which is why E5 is unread rather than failed.

E3.identity: fail (50 of 379 moved, evidence identical on all 50)

E5.measured: the control's census has no `queries` field — the counter was merged between the two dispatches

disposition.reading: E1 fail by five questions, E2 pass, E4 pass, E5 unread, E3 fail
disposition.rule: §13.377.5's gate on E3 — an unreadable delta is not evidence about the mechanism
disposition.row3: not licensed: row 3 requires an attributable delta, and this pair's non-target prompts moved
disposition.family: stays open; `S18` re-runs the pair at one tree before anything is closed
disposition.ledgerRow23: stays `instrument`; its reason changes from 'a candidate awaiting a dispatch' to a dispatch made and not yet attributable
